name: Kiss or Kill
source:
Kiss or Kill is a multi-route mystery thriller visual novel set in a reality dating show that doubles as a death game. The protagonist, a programmer at SIG Corporation, becomes trapped inside a holographic simulation styled as a romance show, where 200 participants are divided into groups of one woman and three men and must survive a seven-day experiment monitored by an AI host. During the day, contestants complete romance tasks to maintain their HeartFlutter ratings; at night, the protagonist can investigate the truth behind the simulation. Contestants whose ratings fall too low are executed.

The game features six romanceable characters, multiple endings, and a hidden route.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4676960/Kiss_or_Kill/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《Kiss or Kill》是一款将恋爱真人秀与死亡游戏融为一体的多路线悬疑惊悚视觉小说。身为SIG公司程序员的主角意外被困在一场包装成恋爱综艺的全息模拟实验之中——200名参与者被划分为“一女三男”的四人小组，必须在AI主持人的严密监控下熬过为期七天的残酷实验。白天，参赛者需要完成各类恋爱任务以维持自己的“心动值”评分；到了夜晚，主角则能暗中调查这场模拟实验背后的真相。一旦参赛者的评分跌破底线，便会当场遭到处决。

游戏包含六名可攻略角色、多重结局以及一条隐藏路线。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4676960/Kiss_or_Kill/]Steam[/url]]
